edges.rationale: Preference finetuning methods such as RLHF typically require a model that has already undergone SFT to convert text-completion behavior into instruction-following dialogue before aligning outputs with human preferences.
Parameter-efficient finetuning techniques such as LoRA and PEFT are applied to the SFT stage to reduce compute and memory requirements compared to full finetuning.
Practical frameworks like PEFT and tactics such as model merging and multi-task finetuning build upon parameter-efficient finetuning techniques.
Finetuning frameworks and tactics such as full finetuning and multi-task finetuning are practical implementations of the SFT stage.
Finetuning frameworks and tactics include practical tools and methods for implementing preference finetuning such as RLHF.
The post-training workflow defines the overall sequence where SFT is a key stage following pre-training.
The post-training workflow defines the overall sequence where preference finetuning is a key stage following SFT.
The post-training workflow includes parameter-efficient finetuning as a technique used during the SFT stage.
The post-training workflow encompasses the practical tools and tactics used for implementing finetuning strategies.
